scenepilot.name: ScenePilot
scenepilot.intro: Follow a real Browser Lite study from source media through an edited sequence.
slides: Gather the material
Start with the footage and sound that give the sequence its direction.

ScenePilot Browser Lite showing source media in an example project.
Find the first cut
Arrange shots on the timeline and look for a rhythm that feels right.

Refine the transitions
Adjust how each moment connects and keep edit decisions in view.

Return to the sequence

luma.name: Luma
luma.intro: Move from a starting image to a considered visual through real Luma workspace captures.
slides: Begin with an image
Bring a photograph or texture into a canvas you can shape.
/assets/after-hours/luma-01-source.png
Luma workspace with the After Hours poster source image.
Give the idea a voice
Use type and layers to make the composition feel intentional.
/assets/after-hours/luma-02-type.png
Luma workspace with typography added to the poster.
Shape the tone
Adjust color while keeping the underlying layers available.
/assets/after-hours/luma-03-tone.png
Luma Tone workspace applying a color adjustment.
See the finished study
Review the complete artwork in Luma's editing workspace.
/assets/after-hours/luma-04-finished.png
Completed After Hours poster study shown in Luma Studio.

form.name: Form
form.intro: A model grows through small, visible decisions. Explore a real Form Studio example from proportion to material studies.
slides: Start from a sketch
Give the model a first shape, then use the editor to work through it.
/assets/after-hours/form-01-proportions.png
Form Studio editing an early proportion study.
Adjust the form
Refine geometry and inspect the result from the working view.
/assets/after-hours/form-02-wider-frame.png
Form Studio showing a wider frame in the example model.
Try a material
Explore how the design reads with a different material.
/assets/after-hours/form-03-brass.png
Form Studio example model with brass material applied.
Compare the finish
Review another material treatment before choosing a direction.
/assets/after-hours/form-04-steel.png
Form Studio example model with brushed steel material controls visible.

stemdeck.name: StemDeck
stemdeck.intro: Build a mix by listening to the parts together. Follow a real browser-session example from stems to blend.
slides: Bring in the parts
Start with tracks or already-separated stems in the browser mixer.
/assets/after-hours/stemdeck-01-parts.png
StemDeck Browser Mixer showing four loaded decks in a study.
Find the entry points
Set cues and loops so each part can join the mix where it belongs.
/assets/after-hours/stemdeck-02-cues.png
StemDeck example showing cue controls across four decks.
Blend the layers
Balance the parts and listen for the moment they become one mix.
/assets/after-hours/stemdeck-03-blend.png
StemDeck study showing a four-part blend in progress.
Keep a take
Explore the browser capture workflow for a short performance.
/assets/after-hours/stemdeck-04-export.png
StemDeck browser companion with capture and export controls.

bounce.name: Bounce
bounce.intro: Explore how Bounce brings local audio, sound shaping and a saved playlist into one personal listening flow.
slides: Bring your own music
Start with audio files you choose; Bounce has no streaming catalog.
/assets/after-hours/bounce-01-listening.png
Bounce browser companion playing a local audio example.
Shape the sound
Use the browser companion's EQ controls to adjust the listening balance.
/assets/after-hours/bounce-02-eq-seek.png
Bounce browser companion showing equalizer and seek controls.
Find a track
Search the local library and move through the queue.
/assets/after-hours/bounce-03-search.png
Bounce browser companion searching a local music library.
Keep a playlist
Save a local playlist for your next browser session.
/assets/after-hours/bounce-04-retained.png
Bounce browser companion showing a retained playlist example.

ghost.name: Ghost Studio
ghost.intro: Explore a garment from reference to a model you can inspect in real Ghost Studio example captures.
slides: Start with references
Bring reference images into a garment study before shaping the model.
/assets/after-hours/ghost-01-references.png
Ghost Studio example with garment reference images.
Shape the silhouette
Adjust the garment and inspect how it sits on the mannequin.
/assets/after-hours/ghost-02-relaxed.png
Ghost Studio jacket study on the mannequin.
Check another view
Rotate the model to inspect it from another angle.
/assets/after-hours/ghost-03-back.png
Ghost Studio jacket study viewed from the back.
Choose what to keep
Review available project and image outputs for the current edition.
/assets/after-hours/ghost-04-export.png
Ghost Studio export panel showing project and image options.

librarian.name: Librarian
librarian.intro: Make a reading space for references you return to. Follow an example from PDF to saved library.
slides: Bring in a reference
Add documents you want to keep close and return to.
/assets/after-hours/librarian-01-field-notes.png
Librarian example with field notes in the reading workspace.
Make the shelf yours
Use the library view to organize and find material again.
/assets/after-hours/librarian-02-sound-palette.png
Librarian example showing an organized personal library.
Settle into reading
Adjust the reading view to suit the document and the moment.
/assets/after-hours/librarian-03-dark-reading.png
Librarian reader using a dark reading appearance.
Return to your notes
See a saved reading state and the reference ready to reopen.
/assets/after-hours/librarian-04-retained.png
Librarian example showing retained reading state.

reclaim.name: Reclaim
reclaim.intro: Review before you act. This read-only workflow surfaces potential duplicates and prepares a report without changing source files.
slides: Choose what to review
Start with a folder you want to inspect; Reclaim is read-only.
/assets/after-hours/reclaim-01-review.png
Reclaim file-review interface before acting on any files.
Inspect possible duplicates
Compare candidate files and decide what deserves a closer look.
/assets/after-hours/reclaim-02-duplicates.png
Reclaim showing candidate duplicate files for review.
Narrow the search
Filter results before making your own decision.
/assets/after-hours/reclaim-03-search.png
Reclaim interface filtering a file review.
Take away a report
Export a review summary while leaving source files untouched.
/assets/after-hours/reclaim-04-report.png
Reclaim report view for a read-only file review.

autocut.name: AutoCut
autocut.intro: Start with footage and a song, then explore beat-aware cut controls. AutoCut is an alpha; results depend on material and device.
slides: Start with your footage
Choose clips and music to begin a beat-aware edit.

AutoCut starting screen showing where to add a song and clips.
Shape a cut
Explore style, pace and framing controls in a sample workspace.
/assets/tool-products/autocut.webp
AutoCut actual workspace with a sample project loaded.

board.name: Board
board.intro: Move from a written idea toward a plan you can see. Board is an alpha workflow for scripts, shot lists and storyboards.
slides: Begin with the idea
Bring a script or outline into a film-planning workspace.
/assets/creative-tools/board.webp
Board starting workspace for a film-planning project.
Make the plan visible
Explore the Board workspace for shot-list and storyboard planning.
/assets/tool-products/board.webp
Board actual workspace with a planning example.

canvas.name: Canvas
canvas.intro: Give a track a visual companion. Explore the browser alpha's audio-reactive loop workflow and current limits.

Bring audio into the visual workspace to shape a loop around it.

Canvas starting workspace for an audio-reactive visual.
Shape the visual
Explore the current loop controls in an actual Canvas capture.

Canvas actual workspace capture showing visual controls.

captions.name: Captions
captions.intro: Make dialogue easier to follow. Captions is an on-device transcription alpha; review recognition before relying on the result.
slides: Bring in a clip
Start with a supported video or audio file on your device.
/assets/creative-tools/captions.webp
Captions starting workspace for a local media file.
Review the words
Explore the caption workspace and check the transcript against the audio.

Review the embedded Glyph workspace and font-making controls.

grade.name: Grade
grade.intro: Find a look in a reference, then explore a transfer to your clip. Grade is an alpha; results depend on source material.
slides: Choose a reference
Start with a still whose color and contrast you want to explore.

Key & BPM starting workspace for track analysis.
